stabiliser. This stabiliser was removed and rock bit run and no similar problems were seen again through this section. This indicated it was not formation pressure related incident. Regular wiper trips were made which all showed tight hole and backreaming often occurred. No fill was ever seen on bottom and at TD, after wiper trip no further drag was seen *when pulling out to surface. It was suggested that the filter

system proved to give excellent inhibition, keeping the instable clay formations in lower Hordaland and upper Rogaland Gruops in check. With other types of water based mud systems, these formations have been known to swelling and sloughing after being exposed for 5-7 days.
